question.worked_solution:
First, we clear the rational expression by multiplying the equation through by $7$:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5-x}{3} & =7x-15 \\ 3(\frac{5-x}{3}) & =3(7x-15) \\ \cancel{3}(\frac{5-x}{\cancel{3}}) & =21x-45 \\ 5-x & =21x-45\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve the remaining equation using the addition and multiplication principles:

$$
\begin{aligned}5-x & =21x-45 \\ 5-x+x & =21x-45+x \\ 5 & =22x-45 \\ 5+45 & =22x-45+45 \\ 50 & =22x \\ \frac{50}{22} & =\frac{22x}{22} \\ \frac{25}{11} & =\frac{\cancel{22}x}{\cancel{22}} \\ x & =\frac{25}{11}\end{aligned}
$$
